data.name: Fold-CP Experimental
data.description: Experimental single-example Boltz-2 inference using DTensor context parallelism (CP) across multiple GPUs. Accepts either a prepared Boltz YAML / FASTA input or a preprocessed Boltz directory, then launches the checked-out Fold-CP fork through torch.distributed.

modes.name: Distributed Prediction
modes.description: Run Fold-CP multi-GPU structure prediction from a prepared Boltz input path

params.name: input_path
params.description: Path to a Boltz YAML / FASTA input file, directory of configs, or preprocessed Boltz directory

params.name: gpu_ids
params.description: Comma-separated host GPU IDs to expose to the CP run. If omitted, the scheduler-assigned GPU is used for standalone launches.

params.name: backend
params.description: Large-protein experimental backend. dram-context-spill-workhorse runs the current DRAM-backed live-state operation proof; shared-cache-serial-output-tiling is only the legacy serial Boltz output slicing path.

params.name: shard_plan_id
params.description: Logical Fold-CP shard geometry identifier (1x1, 2x2, or 4x4); physical launch width is derived from this plan and the available GPU pool

params.name: input_format
params.description: Input layout for the Fold-CP CLI (config_files or preprocessed)

params.name: output_format
params.description: Output structure format written by Fold-CP (mmcif or pdb)

params.name: write_full_pae
params.description: Write full PAE matrices in the confidence outputs

params.name: recycling_steps
params.description: Number of Boltz trunk recycling iterations

params.name: diffusion_samples
params.description: Number of independent diffusion samples to draw

params.name: seed
params.description: Optional random seed for deterministic comparisons
